user_prompt: My landlord hit me with a late fee but I paid on time. Can you write a reply disputing it? Keep it firm but polite.
final_prompt:
My landlord hit me with a late fee but I paid on time. Can you write a reply disputing it? Keep it firm but polite.

<document>
From: Dana Whitfield, Maple Court Apartments
Subject: Late fee - Unit 3B

Hi,

Our records show this month's rent was received on the 3rd. As you know, rent is due
on the 1st, so a late fee of $75 has been added to your account. We were disappointed
to see this, since on-time payments help us keep the building running for everyone.
We'd appreciate it if you could be more careful going forward. Please pay the fee
along with next month's rent.

Thanks for understanding,
Dana

---
Lease excerpt (Maple Court residential lease):
Section 4.1: Rent is $1,450 per month, payable by check, money order, or the resident
portal.
Section 4.2: Rent is due on the 1st. A grace period applies through the 5th; no late
fees may be charged during the grace period.
Section 4.3: Returned payments incur a $35 fee.
Section 9.4: Notices to the landlord must be in writing and may be sent by email.
</document>

segments.text: My landlord hit me with a late fee but I paid on time.
Can you write a reply disputing it?

baseline_runs.answer:
Here's a firm but polite reply you can send:

---

Subject: Re: Late fee - Unit 3B

Hi Dana,

Thank you for your message. I've reviewed my lease, and I'd like to point out that Section 4.2 provides a grace period through the 5th of the month, during which no late fees may be charged. My rent payment was received on the 3rd, which falls within that grace period, so I don't believe the $75 late fee applies.

Could you please review the account and remove the charge? Please confirm in writing once it has been reversed, and let me know if you need any documentation from my end (such as the payment confirmation from the resident portal).

I'm happy to keep paying on time each month, and I appreciate your help in getting this resolved.

Best regards,
[Your name]
Unit 3B

---

A few tips:
- Attach or reference your payment confirmation showing the date received.
- Keep a copy of this email and any response for your records.
- If the fee isn't removed, you can follow up in writing and, if needed, contact your local housing authority or a tenant rights organization.
